title: Spawnteleporter
description: A lightweight and fully configurable spawn‑token system with a GUI shop, JSON storage, teleport countdown, and admin tools.
body:
📌 Spawntoken – A Modern Token‑Based Spawn System for Minecraft Servers

Spawntoken is a clean, fast, and fully configurable plugin that introduces a token‑based teleport system.
Players can teleport to the server spawn using Spawn Tokens, which they can purchase through an intuitive GUI shop.

All data is stored in JSON files, making the plugin extremely lightweight and easy to manage.
No YAML configs, no databases, no dependencies — just drop it in and go.

 

✨ Features

🎯 Teleport to Spawn with a 5‑Second Countdown

Players must stand still during the countdown
Moving cancels the teleport
Includes sound effects for:
Countdown start
Each second
Teleport success
Teleport cancellation
🛒 GUI Token Shop

Open with /tokenshop
Buy tokens with a single click
Shows:
Token cost
Required material
Your current token balance
Items cannot be taken out of the GUI
Fully JSON‑driven
💰 Configurable Token Costs

Admin command:

/spawntokenset

Example:

/spawntokenset ender_pearl 4

📍 Set the Global Spawn

/setspawn

🚀 Teleport Command

/spawn

Consumes 1 token automatically.

💾 JSON Storage

tokens.json → stores player token balances
settings.json → stores spawn location + token cost settings
🔧 No Dependencies

Works on Paper / Spigot 1.21+
No Vault required
No economy plugin needed
 

🟩 Commands

 
 
/spawn
 
/tokenshop
 
/tokenshop
 
/spawntokenset
 
/setspawn
 
 

🟩 Permissions

 
 
spawntokens.admin
/spawntokenset/setspawn
